notes: Seven modules for four proposals. P040 is split into tor_exit_local (local TorDNSEL bulk list + Onionoo running summary, disclosure none, allowed at TLP:RED), tor_onionoo (third-party details only for IPs already matched locally: a non-Tor IP never leaves the machine) and tor_exit_history (dated CollecTor/mthcht checks). P047 is split into ip_offline_db (IPtoASN + bgp.tools) and ip_offline_geo (DB-IP Lite, requires the optional maxminddb package) because POL-13 (packages) and POL-14 (missing large dataset) are module-level gates. Decisions to confirm: (1) tor_exit_history is default_enabled=False (deviation): its monthly 8-15 MB archives are large datasets that POL-14 would report missing on every IP scan, and the council allows history only when a date is known - entities carry no date, so the user opts in and sets tor_exit_history_dates (backlog rows 2-3). (2) bgp.tools needs the setting contact_email (team role mailbox) for the mandatory descriptive UA; without it the source is SKIPPED 'config' and was never called live. (3) ip_blocklists has terms noncommercial (some feeds) with per-feed allowed_sources: under corporate only Spamhaus DROP/ASN-DROP, Feodo/SSLBL, IPsum and Binary Defense run; restricted hits carry restricted: true. (4) The Feodo/SSLBL dataset names (ip_blocklists.feodo.json, ip_blocklists.sslbl.csv) are also registered by p1-G07-1's abusech module with the same names and URLs - one download serves both; the last import wins on validator/metadata, so the batch test asserts only rejection + kept copy. (5) shodan_internetdb (P043) was upgraded in place: manual 404 handling ({'detail': 'No information available'} -> info finding + EMPTY, other 404 -> ERROR), tag attributes, shared hostnames expand=False, 'last seen unknown' on ports, risky ports capped at MEDIUM, CVEs collapsed into one version-inferred finding with CVE pivots at 0.5, min_interval 1.0; its fixtures 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 were rescrubbed (co-tenant names) and 3 fixtures added. (6) The maxmind provider and its two keys are registered but unused until the GeoLite2 core support lands. Gates: registry contract green for all 7 modules, provider registry 0 errors, P327 lint clean on 7 modules + 32 data fragments, ruff clean on all batch Python files. Batch tests: 131 collected, 124 passed, 7 live skipped offline (all 7 passed with V3LUM_LIVE=1). Full offline suite (final run): 4,984 tests, 18 failed, 76 skipped, 0 errors - every failure is a core/top-level test outside this batch and failed again on re-run: test_engine_status_mapping x12 (engine in flux: select() tuples, status ranks), test_context::test_ctx_http_error_markers_and_keyless (QuotaExceeded on test_provider), test_datasets::test_first_run_hint_and_update_all (counts all essential datasets of loaded modules; passes in isolation), test_links x2 (cert_fingerprint template of another pack; legacy single-link expectation), test_net_connector::test_a_socks_proxy_refusing_the_target_is_a_socket_error (A7 PolicyError) and test_tools::test_forced_args_are_appended_and_the_rate_is_clamped.
